title: Which atom change is negative?
statement:
For which hydrogen transition is the atom’s ΔE negative?

[_]{a}

explanations: This is upward and absorbs energy.

hints: Energy levels rise as n rises.
The atom loses energy in emission.
Pick the only decrease in n.
solution: Energy levels rise as n rises. The atom loses energy in emission. Pick the only decrease in n. This is a downward transition.
